# Commit hashes before and after the history rewrite of 15 November 2026

On 15 November the history was rewritten once, before anyone had cloned the repository, to remove the `Co-Authored-By` lines that listed Claude as a contributor and to set the commit author's email to the account's GitHub address. Nothing else in any commit changed. Every commit got a new hash. Hash references in the repository's files were updated in the commit that adds this file; this table resolves any other reference (for example in a result file's history or an old link).
